fr.sorbonne_u.components.cyphy.plugins.devs

Class StandardCoordinatorPluginFactory

  • java.lang.Object
    • fr.sorbonne_u.components.cyphy.plugins.devs.StandardCoordinatorPluginFactory
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    CoordinatorPluginFactoryI, java.io.Serializable

    public class StandardCoordinatorPluginFactory
extends java.lang.Object
implements CoordinatorPluginFactoryI, java.io.Serializable
    The class StandardCoordinatorPluginFactory defines a standard coordinator plug-in factory which creates the coordinator plug-in from a given class; if no class is given, the standard on is used.

    Description

    Implementation Invariants

     invariant       true        // no more invariant

    Invariants

     invariant       getPluginClass() != null

    Created on : 2020-12-11

    Author:
    Jacques Malenfant
